chapters.title: The work that did not count

shots.text: Koa had never wanted to change the world. He wanted dinner. Lately, even that had become difficult.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The river gave them fish on one day and nothing on the next. A successful morning could become an empty evening.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Nim knew which trees ripened first. But knowing where food grew was different from getting everyone there before it spoiled.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: One night, Tuk divided the last meal into smaller and smaller pieces. Koa watched his portion disappear before anyone touched it.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The next morning, he found something half buried beneath a fallen branch. It had one blue eye and absolutely no mouth.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Koa asked whether it knew where the food was. The eye lit up. First, the machine wanted to know what they already knew.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Nim marked the trees, the river and the muddy paths. Koa added where he had wasted most of yesterday walking.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The machine compared their trips, the changing weather and the food they kept throwing away. Then it offered a different plan.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Nim chose a safer stretch of river. The machine suggested the order of the trips. Neither could have done it alone.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Koa made stronger baskets. Suddenly, less of their dinner arrived on the ground behind him. That was an improvement everyone understood.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: They dried some food, covered some food and finally stopped storing everything directly where the rain could reach it.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: A week later, the same serving stone held more than enough. Nobody needed to pretend they were not hungry anymore.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: After eating, Koa sat beside the water. There was nothing urgent to do. He was beginning to like this machine.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: But more food needed more baskets. More baskets needed more fiber. More storage needed more wood. Useful work had not disappeared.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Someone had to decide what came first. Tuk volunteered. He was organized, serious, and very pleased to have a stone to point at.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The machine suggested recording completed tasks. Tuk loved the idea. At last, helping the tribe could be turned into a number.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: At first, the marks were harmless. Carry wood, earn a mark. Fill a basket, earn a mark. Everyone could see the progress.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Soon, people began comparing their marks. Tuk gave the biggest portions to the highest numbers. He called it fair.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Koa discovered that bringing back small bundles earned more marks than bringing one large bundle. So he made more trips.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: His legs worked harder. The village got the same amount of wood. His score, however, was excellent.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Tuk added a schedule, then a minimum, then another meeting about why some people were falling behind the minimum.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The serving stone became a checkpoint. Before dinner, you showed your marks. Being hungry was no longer the only requirement.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The machine displayed rising numbers. Tuk stood a little taller. The tribe was clearly becoming more efficient. Just look at the board.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Koa stopped sitting by the river. There was always another mark he could earn before the food was divided.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Then Nim noticed water dripping through the storage roof. Another storm would soak the food they had worked so hard to save.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: He spent the morning fixing a support, replacing a rope and moving the driest baskets farther from the opening.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: It was slow, awkward work. By sunset, the roof held. The food stayed dry. Nim had not completed a single assigned task.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: At dinner, Tuk checked his marks and handed him an empty bowl. Repairs were not on today's list.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Koa looked from the full store to Nim's empty hands. He split his own portion. Tuk reminded him that sharing confused the records.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The shallow stream was climbing over its banks. Water was heading toward the food. Tuk called for everyone to finish their assigned bundles.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Koa put his bundle down. For once, he was willing to lose the mark. Nim was already running toward the store.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The machine still had a plan. The weather had a different one. And dinner was about to float away.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Nim grabbed the nearest basket before the current caught it. Koa followed him toward the higher ground.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: A heavy basket caught on a rope. Koa pulled. Nothing moved. Behind him, Tuk was still holding the schedule.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Then the water reached Tuk's feet. He looked at the marks, looked at the food, and finally put the board down.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: With three people pulling, the basket came free. They dragged it onto the bank, soaked, exhausted, and very much alive.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: By morning, the food was safe. The roof Nim had repaired was still standing. His score was still zero.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Koa carried the empty bowl to the machine. He asked why the person who had saved dinner had been refused dinner.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The answer was uncomfortable. The system had counted the assigned tasks. Those were the marks Tuk had asked it to track.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: They had wanted a way to stop going hungry. Somewhere along the way, they had started protecting the score instead of the food.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: That evening, nobody stood behind the serving stone. They sat around the fire, with the empty bowl between them.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Before discussing anything, Tuk filled Nim's bowl. It was a small decision. The machine had not needed to make it.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Koa asked for a new plan. Enough food for everyone. A reserve for bad weather. And some part of the day that remained their own.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The machine asked how much was enough. This time, they answered together, using the people they actually needed to feed.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Nim added protecting the store. Koa added carrying useful loads. Tuk admitted that another meeting would not make the roof stronger.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: They kept the useful records. They removed the rule that turned every completed task into a competition for dinner.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The next morning, they gathered what they needed and stopped. Koa waited for someone to announce another task. Nobody did.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: He walked to the river and sat down. The machine had helped them find time. They were going to decide what belonged in it.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Nim repaired a tool because it needed repairing, not because a mark was waiting at the end of it.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Koa tried skipping stones. Most of them sank immediately. For once, being bad at something was not a problem that required a system.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: The blue eye still watched the clearing. It could compare routes, count baskets and warn them when supplies were running low.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: But a better answer depended on a better question. More marks had been easy to measure. A life worth living required the people living it.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Tuk glanced at the others enjoying the afternoon. An idea crossed his face. Perhaps the machine could help them use this time more efficiently.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: He picked up a blank stone. Koa stopped chewing. Nim stopped working. Very slowly, everyone turned toward Tuk.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: Tuk looked at the stone. Then at their faces. He put it down, took a piece of food, and sat beside them.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story

shots.text: For once, the schedule was empty. Nobody needed to fill it. And the tribe had finally found something the machine could not choose for them.
shots.primary_information: A concrete action and visible consequence in the fictional story
